the phage RNA replication cycle was completed within 30 min after the adsorption of Qbeta to host cells.
a single Qbeta infection cycle is completed in about 105 min, in which the phage particle is produced from 1 molecule of Qbeta RNA and a few molecules of coat protein in the host cell.
a single Qbeta RNA molecule in the infected cell is translated into 130 molecules of the beta-subunit and then into approximately 2000 molecules of the coat protein.
